intro: Welcome to Quiz Rush! The lights are on! Forty famous cities, photographed at night. Can you recognise them in the dark? You have ten seconds each. Ready? Let's play!
outro: Lights out, that's the end! How many cities did you recognise? Drop your score in the comments, and come back tomorrow, there's a brand new quiz every day on Quiz Rush!
